subject: plot(marginal_effects(...)) not plotting all data points

messages.author: 7a130b125a3b3d88
messages.subject: plot(marginal_effects(...)) not plotting all data points
parts:
I am trying to plot the predicted marginal effects conditioned on my grouping variable, "Line", but for some reason the response data points are only being plotted for four out of the 28 different levels of this grouping variable.

My data and model have the following structure, where Tool is a factor with five levels and depth, length, and OD are all continuous variables:

formula = bf(DepthError ~ (1|Line) + Tool + Depth + Length + OD,
             sigma ~ Tool + Depth + Length + OD)
 
conditions = data.frame(Line=unique(data$Line))
rownames(conditions) = unique(data$Line)
plot(marginal_effects(fit, conditions=conditions, re_formula=NULL, method='predict'), ncol=5, points=TRUE)

Any thoughts on what I am doing wrong?

Thank you!

messages.author: 6e3dd74b422c061b
messages.subject: Re: [brms-users] plot(marginal_effects(...)) not plotting all data points
parts: That's intentional. Marginal effects conditions on all other predictors and if one of them is a factor, it will only show the points of the factor level specified in condtions (or the first level otherwise). See also ?brms::marginal_effects
